EVENT_DESCRIPTION: Very large hail 6-7cm i.d. damaged cars and smashed car rear windows , damaged roofs / siding, smashed windows, demolished greenhouses. Affected area: All settlements, villages and smaller towns in Bad Tölz-Wolfratshausen County: from Benediktbeuern (incl. Bichl to the N and N of Kochel + suburbs and areas) to eastern direction from Bad Tölz (northernmost) to Lenggries (southernmost) and all settlements in these areas and in between. 80% of all roofs damaged to serious degree. Churches also affected as well as historical buildings. House sidings also show signs of wind-driven hail impact.
REFERENCE: "Extremwetter im Oberland:"Als wäre der Krieg ausgebrochen"", SÜDDEUTSCHE ZEITUNG, 27 AUG 2023. Radar checked. Places and time matched with radar.

Bichl to the N and N of Kochel + suburbs and areas) to eastern direction from Bad Tölz (northernmost) to Lenggries (southernmost) and all settlements in these areas and in between. 80% of all roofs damaged to serious degree. Churches also affected as well as historical buildings. House sidings also show signs of wind-driven hail impact.
REFERENCE: "Extremwetter im Oberland:"Als wäre der Krieg ausgebrochen"", SÜDDEUTSCHE ZEITUNG, 27 AUG 2023. Radar checked. Places and time matched with radar.

Bichl to the N and N of Kochel + suburbs and areas) to eastern direction from Bad Tölz (northernmost) to Lenggries (southernmost) and all settlements in these areas and in between. 80% of all roofs damaged to serious degree. Churches also affected as well as historical buildings. House sidings also show signs of wind-driven hail impact.
REFERENCE: "Extremwetter im Oberland:"Als wäre der Krieg ausgebrochen"", SÜDDEUTSCHE ZEITUNG, 27 AUG 2023. Radar checked. Places and time matched with radar.

CONTACT: Maarten Reyniers, Royal Meteorological Institute of Belgium
DETAILED_LOCATION: Menuchenet, in forest very close to the "Recyparc de Bouillon"
EVENT_DESCRIPTION: Event occurred entirely in forest, therefor there are no eyewitnesses and limited reports in media.    A damage survey was conducted at the impacted area on 28.06.2023, with drone equipment.    Impressions of this survey:    - Most damage is very local, in an area of ~100 by 100 m2. Within that area, the damage is enormous: large healthy trees (eg beeches) that are completely uprooted or snapped. Outside that area there is still an uprooted tree here and there, but very sporadic.  - The fall direction of the trees was fairly consistent, i.e., within a certain area the fall direction is more or less the same; but on a larger scale, I saw different directions. It was difficult to determine a very clear pattern in the fall direction, but on the drone images you might be able to reconstruct a rotation (the pattern is in any case difficult to reconcile with downburst).  - There is not immediately a clear long stretched damage path. In this case, one might assume a brief "touchdown" from the tornado. Someone from the Département de la Nature et des Forêts was also on site today to make an inventory of the fallen trees. This information might be added later.  - The site visit in combination with the radar imagery strongly points to a tornado that only briefly touched the ground.    In the area that was impacted, certainly more than half of the trees was uprooted or snapped. Given the fact that it concerned average to strong trees, this results in an IF1.5 to IF2 tornado on the new ESSL scale (DI: Tree stand - TS).    Please contact me via email for the images and videos I made of the impacted area, in order to assess the final IF scale by an ESSL expert.

EVENT_DESCRIPTION: Damage started south of Hassloch and continues towards northeast. The path of destruction was too small to be from a microburst. The Doppler Radar show a clear sign of rotation on the ground. In a nearby forest trees lie crisscross. A roof was lifted and pulled to the side. Portal toilets and waste containers were lifted over a 3 meter high fence. --- Analysis (T.Kühne (ESSL)): Witness videos show clear strong wet downburst. Radar signature (velocity) underlines a divergent dipol with winds spreading towards the flanks, not towards the center (as it should be for a convergent movement and tornado). Cell motion shows clear downburst acitvity. Tornado ruled out. Nevertheless, intensity of downburst fits with low-end F1 intensity.
REFERENCE: "Tornado-Verdacht - heftiges Unwetter verursacht Schäden in Rüsselsheim", HESSENSCHAU, 21 JUN 2023
